title: Cozy Loft W/ King Bed-Quiet Walkable Neighborhood
description:
Cook in a full kitchen and dine at a farm table especially for the space. The feeling is modern chic, simplicity meets the style of brass faucets, modern lighting, and beautiful floors. Well lit, the space is very homey, with one King Bedroom, One Queen bedroom, and a Queen Sleeper Sofa with extra comfortable beds. The open layout makes the loft feel very spacious.

Location is everything and we are 5 min from downtown, but tucked in a quiet neighborhood!

Short Term Rental Permit #--2016071615

The space
You will love the modern new details and the location! All popular East Nashville is the best place to stay in Nashville. We are close to everything, yet tucked away in a quiet neighborhood with many walkable restaurants and coffee spots! 

Downtown, 5 points and the gulch all a 5-10 min uber or lyft ride!
15 minutes from most hot spots including Grand Ole Opry, Opry Mills,  Centennial Park, Airport and more!

Guest access
Guests are allowed to use the entire upstairs garage apartment, and park right next to the entrance door.

Other things to note
Board games available upon request.
2 Manual Bikes available upon request with $25/day charge
